title: Bridge refactor-baseline archive copy exclusions
goal: Keep base-owned candidate and fixture copies bounded while the frozen refactor baseline moves into the Analysis Stage.
acceptanceCriteria: Trusted package copies omit ci-evidence from exactly the legacy or Stage-owned refactor-baseline path.
Manifest and target-root fixtures apply the same two-path archive exclusion.
No other package, policy or evidence path is excluded.
Package tests and trusted-component candidate validation pass with exact authorization consumption.
